# SS Mugs

> SS Mugs is a China-based stainless steel vacuum insulated bottle and tumbler manufacturer supplying OEM/ODM wholesale programs to European distributors and private-label brands. Capacity range 350–1000ml across 35+ series, 304 food-grade steel, custom logo, low MOQ, 7–15 day lead time.

## Products
- [Product Catalog](https://ssmugs.com/en/products): 47 stainless steel bottle & tumbler series (pastoral, straight, gourd, wide-mouth, bullet, vacuum cola, car cup, coffee cup and more) with full specs, ex-work pricing and carton data.
- [OEM / ODM Capabilities](https://ssmugs.com/en/oem): Custom logo, color, lid, mold and packaging for private-label programs.
- [Factory](https://ssmugs.com/en/about): Vertically integrated stainless steel drinkware manufacturer with in-house molding, welding, painting, printing and QC.

## FAQ
- [FAQ](https://ssmugs.com/en/faq): MOQ, lead time, customization, materials & certifications, payment terms, shipping to Europe / Poland, capacities, samples.

## Other
- [Request a Quote](https://ssmugs.com/en/contact): Inquiry form for wholesale and OEM/ODM orders.
- [Polish site](https://ssmugs.com/pl): Same catalog and FAQ in Polish for the Polish B2B market.
